name: alarm
description: The alarm() function arranges for a SIGALRM signal to be delivered to the calling process after the specified number of seconds. If seconds is zero, it cancels any pending alarm. Any previously set alarm is also canceled.

parameters.name: seconds
parameters.description: Number of seconds until the SIGALRM signal is delivered

return_value.success: Returns the number of seconds remaining until any previously scheduled alarm, or zero if there was no previously scheduled alarm

bugs: alarm() and setitimer(2) share the same timer, so calls to one interfere with the other. Alarms are preserved across execve(2) but not inherited by children via fork(2). Mixing with sleep(3) is not recommended, and scheduling delays may cause arbitrary execution delays.
